characters.notes: Draft reversals/command grabs otherwise match both files: SA2 Étoile 7 / 1-9 in both; CA Pas de Deux is Capcom line 52 with the same 7 / 1-8 as SA3 (SuperCombo line 57 "6+1" / "1-8 Full"); Manège Doré start-ups 10/8/5/8 agree in both. Not listed as missed because they fall outside the six classes or start too late: L/M/H Renversé projectile invulnerability from frame 3 (projectile-only); OD Rond-point air invulnerability from frame 4; H Dégagé low invulnerability from frame 9; OD Dégagé airborne from frame 9 and throw invulnerability from frame 11. Borderline, not listed: SuperCombo line 7 says 2LP's "topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes" (a hurtbox remark, not labelled as invulnerability). Drive gauge costs for Drive Impact/Parry and the Overdrive cost are not stated in either file; "2 Drive bars" follows the draft's own label for OD moves.

missed_options.detail: Holding the button makes frames 1-27 a counter that triggers on a strike OR a throw, then releases a fully invincible counterattack (start-up 7, invincible 1-10). characters.notes: No capcom_only / draft_only entries for Marisa. Supers in the draft agree with Capcom: Meteorite 9 / 1-16, Goddess of the Hunt (SA3 and CA) 13 / 1-19, counter version of SA1 7 / 1-10. Small source difference outside the wake-up window: Meteorite airborne frames are 16 - 48 in Capcom and 17-47 in SuperCombo. Not listed as missed because they start after frame 3: L/M/H Gladius upper-body armor (from frame 5), Phalanx armor (from frame 6/7/10), Dimachaerus air invulnerability (from frame 5/6/10). 2HK projectile-only hurtbox invulnerability on frames 1-7 is outside the six classes. Drive gauge costs are not stated in either file; "2 Drive bars" follows the draft's own label for OD moves.
